key_correction: Earlier 60+h projection assumed policy inference dominated (~1.5 s/call, measured pre-warmup). Batched warm inference is 0.044 s -- 1.9%% of a chunk. The simulator is the bottleneck, so batching the POLICY would not have helped anyway.
implication: 135 episodes/hour single-env is ~4x better than the earlier estimate. A matched SAC/RLPD pilot is feasible overnight without vectorization.
